scientific limitations/integrity: Applies only to the entire vertex set of a Euclidean regular simplex and its exact k-fold Minkowski averages. The all-k Hausdorff profile, finite-domain transition, and exact list/count of farthest points are established by a nearest-composition and hypersimplex proof; finite checks are not treated as an infinite proof. The k-large numerical branch is the classically known covering radius of root lattice A_n and is expressly not claimed as a new lattice theorem. No universal convexification bound or non-Euclidean extension is claimed.
title: Exact deep-hole spectrum of regular-simplex Minkowski vertex averages
